messages:
alex_cheng: Planning to run the users table migration from staging -> prod tomorrow. Need to lock down a canary timing, who's owning smoke, and rollback readiness. target window: 9:30–10:30 PT.

maya_patel: I can own the smoke checks. planning to send a small canary at +10m and +25m. what % traffic for the canary? 1%/5%?

rene_santos: recommend 1% then jump to 10% if metric deltas are good. also confirm dual-write duration — do we keep dualwrite for 48h?

alex_cheng: yes dual-write for 48h. backfill for status_history will run async, expect ~2h, will rate-limit to avoid hotspot.

samuel_ng: @maya_patel I'm free to help with smoke. I'll watch error rates and DB replication lag. what are the smoke assertions?

maya_patel: basic smoke list: 1) api login/refresh within 500ms 2) top-10 user read/write paths 3) sample event ingestion 4) no schema errors in app logs.

alex_cheng: rolling canary plan: 0m -> deploy canary schema changes (migrations that are online), 10m -> 1% writes to new paths, 25m -> 10% if metrics ok, 40m -> full shift. rollback triggers: >2% 5xx, p95 read latency +200ms, or replication lag >5s.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: green-migration-19654321 by alex_cheng. ETA 2026-03-18T09:30:00-07:00.

rene_santos: quick check — do we need a DB maintenance lock for the status_history backfill? if so we should schedule last-minute on-call rotation.

alex_cheng: no global lock. backfill uses chunked updates with `WHERE processed = false LIMIT 1000` loop, will self-throttle. snippet: ```UPDATE status_history SET processed=true WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM status_history WHERE processed=false LIMIT 1000);```

samuel_ng: noted. I'll stub the rollback playbook into the runbook now and add the exact queries to revert the schema mig (rename column back, drop constraint added).

maya_patel: putting a short checklist in docs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/migrations/staging-canary (please add any missing steps).

infra-oncall: oncall standby confirmed for slot 09:15–11:00 PT. paging policy: escalate to infra-sre if DB connections spike > 30% baseline.

alex_cheng: awesome — owners: maya (smoke), samuel (rollback + monitoring), rene (backfill oversight). I'll kick off at 09:30 PT. ping here once canary deploy starts. :thumbsup:

maya_patel: ack. will post a brief thread update at each step.

samuel_ng: ack — I'll have DB rollback SQL ready and a let-ops channel on standby.

alex_cheng: thanks team — final ask: if anyone sees anything odd in preflight (schema lint or migration dry-run), @mention me immediately.
